fusions.name: Unspooled Charge
fusions.desc: Sends a streak of raw arcana that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Overspill
fusions.desc: Lets loose the arcana you have built up, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 4 tiles. You move 30% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Quick Draught
fusions.desc: Restores 20 mana at once. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Crackling Reflexes
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
